# Commit message style

- Generate detailed commit messages with both subject and body.
- Subject line: ≤72 chars, imperative tense, no period.
- Body: 2–4 lines explaining:
  - what changed
  - why it changed
  - any important implementation detail
- Optionally include:
  - affected components
  - breaking changes
  - related issue numbers
- Use conventional style if applicable:
  type(scope): subject
  then body paragraphs.
